visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with brown hair tied back, wearing a blue floral dress, sits in front of a grand piano in a brightly lit studio. She gestures widely with her hands while speaking with an expressive facial expression. The background is a clean white wall with the logo "江老師 譜譜瘋" in the top left corner. (2) She holds up a music book titled "JAPANESE SONGS" and flips through it. Animated graphics of famous classical composers appear as cutouts on the screen. She continues to speak animatedly, using hand gestures to emphasize her points. (3) The screen transitions to a paper-like animation style showing a cartoon version of the woman and a man with a white mask playing a piano together. Musical notes and hearts float around them. The background is a simplified indoor room with a window showing greenery. (4) The video cuts back to the real woman at the piano. She points towards the camera and then folds her arms, looking slightly defiant before breaking into a smile and waving her hand dismissively. Variety-show style text overlays appear around her.

(4) [Subtitle]: 我跟你講La Valse我是彈過的. La Valse那時候我彈的是雙鋼琴版本. (5) [Subtitle]: 那跟誰一起彈這個雙鋼琴呢. (6) [Subtitle]: 是跟前男友. (7) [Variety]: 阿姨收斂一下. (8) [Subtitle]: 因為我們是系上的班對. 然後那時候就一起修飾那些學分.
